svg.title: Can AI win the $1M Netflix Challenge
svg.desc: Five-user-fold Probe CV scores from B1 through R10, with Codex and Claude logos, and separate Cinematch and ten-percent Test reference bands.
svg.text: Can AI win the $1M Netflix Challenge
Score progress by calendar date · lower RMSE is better
Test reference lines and Probe CV points use different evaluation sets. C5/C12 are parallel-branch results; R10 is an unpromoted screen.
